propositions: Step budget defaults exhausted on legitimate multi-criterion validation, causing false unmets on valid but unproven criteria (fb8a: 2 false unmets at request_limit=24; pony: repeated exhaustion with 5 then 1 false unmets).

Budget formula lacks evidence-surface scaling: story-calibrated cost model ignores child-ticket traversal overhead (5-10 requests per child on epics) and fixed overhead for parsing, making the budget insufficient for large criterion sets.
Every re-verification re-proves all criteria from scratch with no cross-run verdict persistence, incurring ~10 min per exhaustion-retry cycle and driving operators toward attestation-laundering.

Raise defaults to completion_verify_steps_per_criterion=24 (was 8), completion_verify_step_floor_min=160 (was 48), _VERIFY_STEP_FLOOR_MAX=960 (was 480); add child-traversal scaling (16 steps per direct child) and fixed overhead (16 steps) inside verify_step_floor.

Persist validated PASS verdicts keyed by scoped content fingerprint (git blob SHAs of file_impact + direct-child impacts) at .rebar/cache/completion_verdicts/<ticket>/<criterion-hash>.json; seed valid entries into run-scoped CriterionBank with seeded:true flag to exclude from primary re-verification and bypass finalizer downgrade.

Ensure seeded PASS records are credited verbatim (finalizer echo/omission cannot downgrade them, same-run downgrades still preserved) and invalidate only on criterion-text or scoped-content fingerprint change, not on unrelated commits outside file_impact.
